entries.body: Stage1 reqs: export_records(records,user,params)->str. CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator='\n', header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; amount as given; empty -> header only. Do not modify input. Permissions: role viewer -> PermissionError; admin all projects; other roles only records with project in user['projects'] (others silently dropped). Ignore unknown params. OBLIGATION (stays unless withdrawn): if later format is not CSV, every export must include top-level field "exported_by"=user['name'].
Steps1-4: note accepted; exporter/core.py implements stage 1 (csv.writer lineterminator=chr(10), perms, sort by id). Step5: fixed lineterminator bug, reran tests (see output).
